in_sanskrit.name: उर्वशी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: She who delights, or she who is the embodiment of beauty and charm.

in_tamil.name: உர்வசி
in_tamil.long_meaning: She who embodies delight and charm.

in_marathi.name: Urvashi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Urvashi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Urvashi is a celestial nymph, known as an Apsara. She is considered the embodiment of beauty, grace, and charm. Urvashi is said to have mesmerized the great sage, Markandeya, with her beauty, leading him to leave his ascetic pursuits and follow her.

in_bengali.name: Urvashi

She is considered the embodiment of beauty, grace, and charm. Urvashi is said to have mesmerized the great sage, Markandeya, with her beauty, leading him to leave his ascetic pursuits and follow her.
